items.name: Modern Grocery first-party product image set
items.author: Modern Grocery product team
items.evidence: Per-file generation references, rights review, fixture mapping and approval are recorded in release/demo-assets.json. These WebPs are optimized derivatives of images generated specifically for this starter and contain no identifiable people, third-party logos or readable branded packaging.

paid_release_blockers: final legal copyright holder/entity and customer-facing non-code asset license treatment reviewed
all redistributed third-party entries approved with evidence
human review completed for ambiguous or proprietary asset licenses
notes: Theme/Core code-package LICENSE/NOTICE presence and GPLv2-or-later header consistency are enforced separately by docs/PACKAGE-LICENSE-CONTRACT.md and package CI.
No third-party font, photo, illustration, icon pack or vendored runtime library is currently approved for redistribution in the engineering-alpha Theme/Core packages.
V1 typography uses system fonts and the product icon direction is first-party minimal SVG; see docs/VISUAL-ASSET-STRATEGY.md.

Canonical first-party demo imagery is governed in detail by release/demo-assets.json. The package inventory records the same exact binary paths because every license-sensitive customer-package file must be explicitly owned; this does not classify the images as a third-party dependency.
Future third-party dependencies still require their own evidence-backed inventory entries and notices where applicable.
